{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Re-check for QA orders: they have revenue = '999999.99' before cleaning
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f'Number of QA orders (exact string match): {df[qa_mask].shape[0]}')

# Now clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# This will reveal if any QA orders were missed
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any values close to 999999.99 after cleaning
qa_threshold = 999999.99
qa_after_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] == qa_threshold]
print(f'Number of rows with revenue_clean == 999999.99: {len(qa_after_clean)}')

# Confirm the QA orders are indeed present
print(f'QA order IDs: {qa_after_clean["order_id"].tolist()}')

# Now proceed: exclude QA orders and refunded orders
completed_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != qa_threshold)].copy()
print(f'Number of completed orders after excluding QA: {len(completed_df)}')

# Sum revenue by channel
channel_revenue = completed_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Channel revenue after QA exclusion: {channel_revenue.to_dict(orient="records")}')

# Determine the channel with highest revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue_clean'].idxmax(), 'channel']
max_revenue = channel_revenue['revenue_clean'].max()

# Output
print(f'Max revenue channel: {max_channel}, Revenue: {max_revenue}')"}
